question: Should Crabline preserve compatibility for existing recorderPath consumers and mismatched-owner artifact directories, or intentionally change both behaviors on upgrade?
rationale: The patch makes two upgrade-visible contract choices that tests can verify mechanically but cannot establish as the intended compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
options.body: Keep recorderPath stable, add a versioned snapshot field, and add an explicit ownership repair or migration path before merge.

options.title: Accept the breaking hardening
options.body: Land the fail-closed ownership and new recorderPath semantics only with explicit approval, upgrade documentation, and real upgrade proof.

options.title: Split the durability work
options.body: Land non-breaking recorder and tombstone hardening separately while pausing the contract-changing portions for design review.

recommendation.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep recorderPath stable, add a versioned snapshot field, and add an explicit ownership repair or migration path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidence-backed repository member connected to the cross-file persistence design in the available context.
